name: budget_01_drop
description: Token budgeting with drop strategy - validates priority-based file selection

behavior: Files sorted by priority DESC, then path ASC
Low priority files dropped when budget exceeded

metadata.purpose: Rust v0.8.0 budget drop strategy validation
metadata.recalibrated: 2026-07 (roadmap 2.1 Q10 follow-up): expected values were fitted against a flat, uncalibrated per-file overhead constant that didn't match the real PlusMinus serializer (see TokenEstimator::estimate_file_tokens_for_format). Recalibrated to the real serializer's output. Also note: test_budget_01_drop's Rust harness never actually feeds this vector's `priorities` map into the LensManager, so selection here is really tie-broken by path ASC (all three files land in the same tier/priority), not by the declared priorities — the resulting order (high, low, medium alphabetically) is what dropped medium_priority.py rather than the lowest declared priority. That's a pre-existing gap in the test harness, out of scope for this recalibration.
